flows:
Navigate to https://www.expansion.com/ then Use the normal visual page and a pointer.
Find the quoted passage directly using page search or vertical scrolling.
Once there, look at the start of the passage, report whether the text fits across the viewport, and stop.
Do not scroll through the rest of the page.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, send or submit anything, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Read the passage beginning “PÓDCAST EN ACCIÓNCómo ganar en la Bolsa española más allá de los” at normal width.
Get whether the start of the passage fits across the viewport at normal width and save it as {{passage_viewport_fit}}.

summary:
The requested text was visibly shown in the homepage’s blue ticker, but the agent continued searching and scrolling instead of checking whether it fit across the viewport and saving the answer. The later podcast-card area contained different content, so treating that area as the required passage led to the failed assertion.
Update the agent to recognize ticker content as visible page content. When page search or the current viewport reveals the complete requested start, it should immediately assess the normal-width fit, save the value, and stop rather than searching for a separate card or article.
one_liner: The run failed because it did not stop and record the result when the requested passage was visible.
reason: The passage appeared only in transient DOM content and could not be brought visibly into the viewport without further scrolling.
